name: Question bank
description: Downloads your vault's question index, answer keys, papers and subject/topic tags, and offers the question pool to the other features. Required by the exam and the dashboard.

settings.name: Load questions in the background
settings.desc: Start downloading as soon as the page opens, so the first test starts faster. When off, questions load the first time a feature asks for them.

settings.name: Index file
settings.desc: Path of the index file in the repository (created by your vault export).

settings.name: Question papers folder
settings.desc: Folder that holds the year files with the question text. Needs a trailing slash.

settings.name: Core question id prefix
settings.desc: Block ids starting with this are treated as core-subject questions.

settings.name: Aptitude question id prefix
settings.desc: Block ids starting with this are treated as General Aptitude questions.
